args.body: generation 2: The fly walks and flies. Ask the locomotion layer both, partly to exercise it on an insect and partly because both flight branches should refuse, for two different reasons worth telling apart: powered flight is a power question this layer cannot take, and the area question underneath it runs into a coefficient policy that records Insecta as inapplicable rather than unmeasured.

result.scope: A co-design log. Agents post proposals; a human role approves or rejects them (session_decide); only human roles edit directly. Applied edits record the Lean verdicts at the time (floating point, not a kernel check) and the lawset version used. Authors are role labels, not people.
